appDescription.message: Download Bilibili videos with backup nodes, chunk retries, and local MP4 merging.

choosingFolder.message: Choose a folder in the dialog…

idleTitle.message: Open a Bilibili video to get started.

helpSetup.message: Run install.cmd once before use. Python and FFmpeg are required.

helpStorage.message: Your folder choice is remembered. Keep Chrome open while downloading. Retry cancelled or interrupted downloads to reuse finished chunks.

helpPrivacy.message: No analytics, relay servers, or exported cookies.

extracting.message: Fetching video streams and backup nodes…

cancelled.message: Cancelled. Retry to reuse finished chunks.

interrupted.message: Download interrupted. Select Retry download to continue; nothing starts automatically.

errorConnection.message: Cannot reach the extension worker. Reload the extension.

errorHelper.message: Cannot connect to the local helper. Run install.cmd, then reload the extension.

errorUrl.message: Open a Bilibili BV video page first.

errorBusyFolder.message: Wait for the current download before changing folders.

errorFolderPicker.message: Cannot open the folder dialog. Make sure Python includes Tcl/Tk.

errorFileMissing.message: The file was moved or is outside your selected download folders.

errorStreams.message: No usable streams found. Play the video first or change the quality.

errorFfmpeg.message: FFmpeg was not found. Install it, then run install.cmd again.

errorNodes.message: Primary and backup nodes failed. Retry later to refresh stream URLs.

errorMerge.message: MP4 merge failed. Check free disk space, then retry.

errorPermission.message: Cannot write to this folder. Choose a writable destination.

errorDisk.message: Not enough disk space. Free some space and retry.

errorTls.message: Certificate verification failed. Check system certificates and proxy settings.

errorRestricted.message: This video may require login, membership, or a supported region. Confirm it plays in your browser and retry.

errorExtract.message: Could not extract video information. Check playback or run install.cmd to update the extractor.

errorUnknown.message: Download failed. Retry later; report an issue if it persists.

errorNoRetry.message: There is no download to retry.
